description: This file defines the UploadedFile class in the Slim Framework PSR-7 implementation. It manages uploaded file data, supports moving files, retrieving file info, and creating instances from global PHP variables.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Implements the PSR-7 UploadedFileInterface; manages uploaded file info, moving files, and creating instances from PHP globals.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadedFile object with file info, stream, and upload status.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a StreamInterface for reading the uploaded file.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path, handling different transfer methods.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the upload error status code.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the original filename provided by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type (MIME type) of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates an array of UploadedFile instances from PHP globals or the provided globals array.

methods.name: parseUploadedFiles
methods.description: Recursively parses the $_FILES array to normalize and create UploadedFile instances.
